# `unix_micros`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
unix_micros(timestamp)
```

Returns the number of microseconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT unix_micros(TIMESTAMP('1970-01-01 00:00:01Z'));
```

Result:

```text
1000000
```
